chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"None of you should let his moustache grow long, for Shaytan takes it as a shield, concealing himself by it."

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يَتَّخِذُهُ: he takes it or adopts it
key_terms.يُطَوِّلَنَّ: to surely let grow long or extend

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about letting the moustache grow long?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers not to let the moustache grow excessively long. It presents personal grooming and cleanliness as part of proper conduct and warns against practices associated with Shaytan.
